note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. There was no contest for any of the 16 seats (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1955, p. 8). Fifteen candidates were nominated and returned unopposed; they are recorded from the Mid-Ulster Mail's list of the nominations (21 May 1955, p. 9, page image read). The only newcomer was Robert Eccles, for Sandholes, in place of Major C. A. M. Alexander. No candidate was nominated for Killeenan, whose retiring member was Mr. Peter Malone; the paper expected the seat to be filled 'later on', and no 1955 source read names its member, so Killeenan is not recorded. No labels are printed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Lissan' to Lissan Lower (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Cookstown Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-46 name the DED Lissan Lower; the rounds were filed as Lissan Lower (1924, 1927, 1936, 1939, 1949, 1961, 1964, 1967); Lissin (1930); Lissan (1933, 1946, 1952, 1955, 1958). This round was filed as 'Lissan', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (lissan) answers with a redirect to this one.
